function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, annual interest rate, and number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The loan amount. This is a float type value.

annual_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: Number of years the mortgage is amortized over.

message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact rate that’s being quoted right now.  
Mortgage rates fluctuate daily based on the economy, lender policies, your credit profile, down‑payment size, loan term, etc.  

Typical ranges (as of early 2026) were roughly:

| Loan type | Typical 30‑yr fixed rate | Typical 15‑yr fixed rate |
|-----------|--------------------------|--------------------------|
| Conventional | ~5.0 – 5.8 % | ~4.2 – 4.9 % |
| FHA | ~5.1 – 5.9 % | ~4.3 – 5.0 % |
| VA | ~4.8 – 5.6 % | ~4.0 – 4.7 % |

If you’re looking for a precise quote, check with a local lender or use an online rate‑comparison tool that pulls current data.
